guideline: We categorized hallucinations into five primary types: Mispronounced/Incorrect characters, Repetition/Deletion Errors, Mid-Generation Collapse, Content Divergence, Prosody Errors.
Human annotators check whether the generated speech aligns with the target text, identifying hallucinations such as mispronunciations, omissions, or repetitions.
